ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
var root = JSON.parse(result);
var list = [];
var seen = {};
function addNovel(items) {
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        var info = items[i].bookInfo || items[i];
        if (!info || !info.bookId) continue;
        list.push({_media:"novel", id:String(info.bookId), title:info.title, author:info.author,
            intro:info.intro, kind:info.category, cover:info.cover, lastChapter:info.lastChapterIdx});
    }
}
function addAudio(items) {
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        var info = items[i].albumInfo || items[i];
        if (!info || !info.albumId || seen[String(info.albumId)]) continue;
        seen[String(info.albumId)] = true;
        list.push({_media:"audio", id:String(info.albumId), title:info.name, author:info.authorName || info.bookAuthor,
            intro:info.intro, kind:info.themeTag || "听书", cover:info.cover,
            lastChapter:info.firstTrackTitle, trackCount:info.trackCount});
    }
}
if (root.books) addNovel(root.books);
else {
    var firstAudioPage = typeof page == 'undefined' || Number(page) <= 1;
    if (root.albums) addAudio(root.albums);
    if (root.items) addAudio(root.items);
    if (firstAudioPage && root.ranklist && root.ranklist.itemList) addAudio(root.ranklist.itemList);
    if (firstAudioPage && root.recommendList) addAudio(root.recommendList);
    if (root.itemList) addAudio(root.itemList);
    if (root.results) {
        for (var resultIndex = 0; resultIndex < root.results.length; resultIndex++) {
            var group = root.results[resultIndex] || {};
            if (group.albums) addAudio(group.albums);
        }
    }
}
result = JSON.stringify(list);
</js>$[*]

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var root = JSON.parse(result);
var list = [];
if (root.trackList) {
    book.type = 32;
    for (var i = 0; i < root.trackList.length; i++) {
        var item = root.trackList[i] || {};
        var track = item.trackInfo || {};
        var extra = item.trackInfoExtra || {};
        list.push({_media:"audio", title:track.title, updateTime:track.updateTime,
            trackId:track.trackId, payType:track.payType, paid:extra.paid,
            trackIdx:track.trackIdx, duration:track.duration});
    }
} else {
    book.type = 8;
    var data = root.data && root.data.length ? root.data[0] : null;
    list = data && data.updated ? data.updated : [];
    for (var j = 0; j < list.length; j++) {
        list[j]._media = "novel";
        list[j]._bookId = String(data.bookId);
        list[j]._format = data.book && data.book.format ? String(data.book.format) : "epub";
        list[j]._synckey = list[j]._format == "txt" ? "0" : String(data.synckey);
    }
}
result = JSON.stringify(list);
</js>$[*]
